proposition.claim:
Equation reference: cov. In dimension two the source fixes a centered, stationary, isotropic, divergence-free Gaussian field \(b\) whose covariance has Fourier transform \[
 \widehat c(k)=\mathbf1_{\{|k|\leq1\}}
       \left(I-\frac{k\otimes k}{|k|^2}\right).\] The convention uses \((2\pi)^{-1}\,\mathrm dk\) in dimension two. With \(X_0=0\), the diffusion satisfies \(\,\mathrm dX_t=\epsilon b(X_t)\,\mathrm dt+\sqrt2\,\,\mathrm dW_t\). The direction \(\xi\) is a unit vector. The drift amplitude \(\epsilon\) is finite; the sharp comparison constants approach one as \(\epsilon\to0\). Infra-red truncation at \(L\geq1\) gives \(b_L=-J\nabla\psi_L\), with \(a_L=I+\epsilon\psi_LJ\) and \(\mathbb E\psi_L^2=\log L\); \(J\) is counterclockwise rotation by \(\pi/2\). The source’s main conclusions compare effective diffusivity with \(\sqrt{1+\epsilon^2\log L}\) and the normalized displacement variance with the corresponding time scale \(L=\sqrt T\). The zero-amplitude and initial-scale cases must remain included.

Recorded check: False terminal coefficient in the exact energy representation

repair.content:
Use terminal coefficient1/2 in(90),(93), the energy definition and all terminal terms of(99). Independently justify the finite-time monotonicity invoked for the all-amplitude lower bound.

Replace the last two forcing signs in(97) by plus signs.

Insert factor i in(20).

Add reflection covariance to the rotation argument.

Restrict M to a fixed bounded admissible range, handle initialstep separately, clarify epsilon dependence, and restore initial1 in page14 display.

Distinguish zero-range independence from finite positive range or remove uniqueness assertion.
